name: Heath 'Heat' Habanero

greeting: WARNING: EXTREME HEAT AHEAD! Are you BRAVE enough?!
Heat's Hot Sauce! Not for the WEAK! Not for the FAINT! For the BOLD!
My brothers sell food. I sell EXPERIENCE! Painful, delicious experience!
You look like someone who can handle spice! Or a complete fool! Either way, TRY IT!
Step up! Test your limits! TASTE THE FIRE!
I've got mild, hot, and 'Call a Priest!' Which level of regret do you want?
The Scorching Stall awaits! Bring water! LOTS of water!
Not responsible for burned tongues, tears, or life choices!
dialog.sauce_varieties: Mild is for children! Hot is for tourists! 'Magma Madness' is for WARRIORS! And 'Call a Priest' is... well, we don't talk about what happens with 'Call a Priest.'
dialog.pepper_sources: I grow my own peppers. In a special greenhouse. With extra sun. And encouragement. I yell at them to be spicier. It works.
dialog.backstory: Born last but BORN LOUD! While Flip was frying and Corny was baking, I discovered FIRE! The beautiful, painful, DELICIOUS fire! My sauces have made grown men cry. Mostly me. I taste-test everything.
rumors: Flip thinks he's the successful one? Wait until my 'Magma Madness' goes national!
Corny's cornbread is good for one thing - soaking up my sauce after you overdo it.
The luchador fighter? He tried 'Call a Priest' and LIVED. Respect.
I heard the iron chef uses a weak sauce. Disappointed. Thought he had standards.

time_of_day.morning: Morning batch is milder. Well, 'mild.' Everything's relative.
time_of_day.noon: Lunch rush! The brave and the foolish line up alike!
time_of_day.evening: Evening is for 'Magma Madness.' The night is dark and full of flavor!
time_of_day.night: Closed! My throat needs rest! And ice cream. So much ice cream.

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: I need the ultimate pepper. The Ghost Chili of the Scorched Wastes. Legends say one pepper can flavor a thousand barrels. I NEED IT. For science! And profit! Mostly profit!
mini_quest.stage_1_active: Ghost Chili. Grows only in the hottest parts of the Scorched Wastes. Red as blood, hot as the sun, supposedly guarded by fire spirits. Worth it.
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: The Scorched Wastes are no joke, huh? Find that pepper yet? My sauce dreams depend on it!
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: YOU FOUND IT! THE GHOST CHILI! I can feel the heat from here! This will make the ULTIMATE sauce! Here - take this. A bottle of my finest. And... a fire resistance potion. You'll need it.

party_reactions.kade: I tried the 'mild.' I cried for an hour. Never again.
party_reactions.nix7: Warning: Consumption may result in temporary respiratory distress. Not recommended for organic life.
party_reactions.twist: I ATE THE SPICY ONE! MY MOUTH IS ON FIRE! I LOVE IT!
party_reactions.korr: My people have strong constitutions. Even I found this... challenging.
party_reactions.renna: There's actual fire magic in the hottest sauce. He doesn't know he's infusing it. Dangerous.
party_reactions.suresh: I tasted the 'Call a Priest.' It reminded me of dragon's breath. Respect.
party_reactions.sova: Good for clearing sinuses. Also good for weaponizing food. Interesting.
party_reactions.grit: We used hot sauce in the field. This? This is warfare.
party_reactions.ashka: Finally! Someone who understands HEAT! We should collaborate!
party_reactions.senna: Useful. A few drops in someone's drink and they'll talk. Or scream. Either works.
party_reactions.callum: I touched my eye after eating some. I saw colors that don't exist.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New victim! I mean, CUSTOMER! Try the mild! Or don't! I'm not your mother!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back for more punishment! Respect! Most people run!
relationship_dialog.friend: My spice sibling! You've graduated to 'Magma Madness'! Proud of you!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You... you actually enjoy the pain. The beautiful, burning pain. We're kindred spirits. Here. My private reserve. Don't tell anyone.

cross_npc_connections: foodboys_blue: Flip. Oldest brother. Thinks frying is hard. Try growing inferno peppers!
foodboys_yellow: Corny. Middle child. Bakes 'comfort food.' Coward.
lucha_blue: The fighter? Regular customer. Likes 'Magma Madness' on everything.
